punchline: At supper on his last day, Seneca spent his time comforting his friends.
thirty_sec: In AD 65 a centurion delivered Nero's order to Seneca at supper in a villa outside Rome. Refused the right to make a will, Seneca told his friends that the example of his life was his best legacy, comforted them, and dictated a farewell as his end came slowly.
question: Who around you will be watching how you handle your next bad day, and what would you like them to see?
key_contrast: With no property to leave, he left an example of steadiness.
